text: This report recommends six candidates for appointment to the McCormick Playground Arena Board.

City Council on July 19 and 20, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council temporarily amend the composition of the McCormick Playground Arena Board by adding two additional public members to serve, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending April 21, 2025, or until such time as their successors are appointed. 2. City Council appoint Monica Reddon to fill one temporary position on the McCormick Playground Arena Board in Part 1 above, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending April 21, 2025, or until such time as their successor is appointed. 3. City Council waive the two-term limit provision of the Public Appointments Policy and appoint Luis Silva to fill one temporary position on the McCormick Playground Arena Board in Part 1 above, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending April 21, 2025, or until such time as their successor is appointed.
